tp4-ar.qualification: Not qualified: the M1 bring-up profile, autoregressive at TP4 on the deepseek-ai checkpoint with the native KV layout, which kv_cache_dtype auto serves. The BF16 KV layout is not a served profile: it is qual.json's kv-bf16 comparison configuration, not qualified for capacity, preemption under pressure or offload. Its evidence is the release preview's full suite at the release revision (models/deepseek41/README.md#qualification).

tp4-dspark.qualification: Not qualified: DSpark at TP4 on the deepseek-ai checkpoint with native KV. Five proposals are computed per block; scheduler budgets select the emitted prefix. Qualification requires AR and speculative arms, exact greedy equality, the declared speculative-verification bounds and GSM8K at least 193 of 200 in each arm.
